sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Lightning Release, Clash

system.description:
You outstretch your hand and launch a stream of prismatic particles of light that overwhelm creatures and their senses. All creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 3d8 lightning damage and are Shocked until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature takes 3d8 lightning damage and gain 1 rank of Shocked.

Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 5d8 lightning damage, gain 1 rank of Shocked and are Firewalled.

Angel Link: Allied creatures, excluding yourself, in range suffer no harmful effects, and gain 1d8 temporary chakra and Signal Boosted until the end of their next turn.

Demon Link: Allied creatures, excluding yourself, in range suffer no harmful effects, and increase the next instance of damage they deal by 1d8.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the Angel and Demon link effects by +1d8. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the Angel and Demon link effects by +1d8.
